title: Tween:Play() / Pause / Cancel
summary: Playback controls on a Tween object: Play starts/resumes from the current values, Pause freezes, Cancel resets to the beginning. Pair with the Completed event for sequencing.

methods.name: Play
methods.description: Starts (or resumes) the tween. Animates from the property's CURRENT value toward the goal.

methods.name: Cancel
methods.description: Stops and resets progress to the beginning (properties snap back when next played from start).

events.name: Completed
events.description: Fires when the tween finishes or is cancelled (state tells you which). Completed:Wait() yields.

properties.name: TimePosition
properties.description: Current position in seconds within the tween.

explanation.whatItIs: The remote control for your tween.
explanation.whyItExists: Animations get interrupted, reversed, chained — controls make that manageable.
whenToUse: Completed:Wait() inside spawned threads for sequential animations
Cancel: interrupt (e.g. the UI closed mid-fade)
whenNotToUse: Pause for permanent hiding — just set the property/Enabled
tips: Completed fires for Cancel too — check the playbackState argument
Replaying after Cancel starts over from current (snapped-back) values
commonMistakes: Calling :Wait() on Completed on the main thread of an event handler — blocks that handler; spawn or defer
Assuming Completed means success — cancellations fire it too

examples.title: Chained animations
examples.code:
local TweenService = game:GetService("TweenService")

task.spawn(function()
    local up = TweenService:Create(part, TweenInfo.new(0.5), { Position = part.Position + Vector3.new(0, 5, 0) })
    up:Play()
    up.Completed:Wait()

    local spin = TweenService:Create(part, TweenInfo.new(1), { CFrame = part.CFrame * CFrame.Angles(0, math.rad(360), 0) })
    spin:Play()
    spin.Completed:Wait()

    print("Sequence done")
end)
